RECURSIVELY SORT the left half (length < n)
RECURSIVELY SORT the right half (length < n)

SHOW that the merged list is sorted (the smallest head element is selected at each step)
SHOW that the merged list is a permutation of the concatenation of the inputs (elements are output exactly once)
CONCLUDE that for any input list, MERGE SORT terminates, returns a sorted list, and returns a permutation of the original list
